source: in01-68ca962ddb239d1 aws-eu, 2026-10-22 19:39-20:22 UTC, 2.6->3.0 upgrade. Modeled as a cold load of 2 tables onto 6 empty nodes. Load model: fitted 45 MiB/s/core with concurrency penalty 1.8 and a QueryNode pool of 64 so that ~50 loads run at once as in the incident (per-load rate ~0.6 MiB/s, so a 300 MiB load does not fit in the 300 s timeout).
